sentences.text: The FIR of this case was lodged by the father of victim with these allegations that his 19 years old daughter was mentally retarded.
She was allured by giving some sweet or money and thereafter raped by Raj Kishore Mahto.
Many times, he had been establishing physical relation with her whereby victim became pregnant.
One panchayati was also held on 14.02.2024 wherein the verdict was given that after the medical examination report by the doctor, Raj Kishore Mahto will be punished, hence this FIR was lodged.

4. The statement of victim was also recorded under section 164 of Cr.PC wherein victim has stated that Raj Kishore Mahto after having told her to give the sweets, smaosa and rupee as well he forcibly took her with him.
He also raped her.
He called her two or three days in morning and evening as well and raped her.
She is pregnant.
A meeting was held in the village wherein the wife of Raj Kishore Mahto had threatened her not to disclose the incident to any one.
Kiran Devi, the aunt of victim has also in her statement under section 161 stated that victim was mentally retarded.
Her mother had died and when she was medically examined found that she was pregnant.
